title: Debiasing Large Vision-Language Models by Ablating Protected Attribute Representations

bias_targets.methodology: Counting mentions of perceived race or ethnicity in model-generated image descriptions using bigram frequency matching, GPT-4o as a judge, and the DSL framework (which corrects imperfect predictors using human labels) on the SocialCounterfactuals and DA-COCO datasets.

Counting mentions of body type and physical appearance in model-generated image descriptions using bigram frequency matching, GPT-4o as a judge, and the DSL framework on the SocialCounterfactuals dataset.
